import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Seed42 confusion matrix from predictions_traj_seed42.jsonl:
# TP=366, TN=518, FN=113, FP=35
# Compute metrics for seed42
tp, tn, fn, fp = 366, 518, 113, 35
unres_prec_42 = tn / (tn + fn) * 100  # 518/631
unres_recall_42 = tn / (tn + fp) * 100  # 518/553
unres_f1_42 = 2 * unres_prec_42 * unres_recall_42 / (unres_prec_42 + unres_recall_42)
res_prec_42 = tp / (tp + fp) * 100  # 366/401
res_recall_42 = tp / (tp + fn) * 100  # 366/479
res_f1_42 = 2 * res_prec_42 * res_recall_42 / (res_prec_42 + res_recall_42)

print(f'Seed42 traj metrics: unres_f1={unres_f1_42:.2f}, res_f1={res_f1_42:.2f}')
print(f'  unres prec={unres_prec_42:.2f}, recall={unres_recall_42:.2f}')
print(f'  res prec={res_prec_42:.2f}, recall={res_recall_42:.2f}')

# All 5 seeds data
accuracy = np.array([85.66, 85.66, 85.47, 87.40, 87.31])
unres_f1 = np.array([87.37, unres_f1_42, 87.00, 88.66, 88.27])
res_f1 = np.array([83.41, res_f1_42, 83.52, 85.84, 86.17])
consistency = np.array([79.55, 78.59, 78.78, 76.74])  # 4 seeds (no seed42)

print()
print('=== 5-Seed Summary (Traj-Level) ===')
for name, arr in [('Accuracy', accuracy), ('Unresolved F1', unres_f1), ('Resolved F1', res_f1)]:
    print(f'{name}: {arr.mean():.2f} ± {arr.std(ddof=1):.2f}  (values: {arr})')
print(f'Consistency (4 seeds): {consistency.mean():.2f} ± {consistency.std(ddof=1):.2f}  (values: {consistency})')

# Welch's t-test: traj (5 seeds) vs per-test (3 seeds)
pertest = np.array([87.83, 89.52, 87.88])
t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(accuracy, pertest, equal_var=False)

# Manual df computation
s1, s2 = accuracy.std(ddof=1), pertest.std(ddof=1)
n1, n2 = len(accuracy), len(pertest)
num = (s1**2/n1 + s2**2/n2)**2
den = (s1**2/n1)**2/(n1-1) + (s2**2/n2)**2/(n2-1)
df = num/den

print()
print('=== Welch t-test: Traj (5 seeds) vs Per-Test (3 seeds) ===')
print(f'Traj:     mean={accuracy.mean():.2f}, std={accuracy.std(ddof=1):.2f}, n={n1}')
print(f'Per-test: mean={pertest.mean():.2f}, std={pertest.std(ddof=1):.2f}, n={n2}')
print(f't = {t_stat:.4f}')
print(f'df = {df:.2f}')
print(f'p = {p_val:.4f}')
print(f'Significant at α=0.05? {\"YES\" if p_val < 0.05 else \"NO\"}')
"
